result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees allocable after termination, and Licensor has no convenience-termination right during any committed term. However, it goes beyond the playbook by permitting termination “in whole or in part” and by making accrued usage amounts Licensee’s “sole payment obligation,” which could unintentionally extinguish other properly accrued obligations or liabilities. The no-penalty and no-acceleration language is generally consistent with the preferred position, but “other amounts” is also unnecessarily broad. Drafting is otherwise clear and professional.
